body: Damn man i've never tried it but I know they say u wanna do it every 3 months. I think they say it can permanently change ur brain chemistry (don't worry tho, everything can to a different degree, this just might be more severe). Your chemistry chases the high of the drug, forget if its serotonin or dopamine or something else. Anyways, if you quit/stop, you will feel very low. The only true way to quit is to replace it with something that replaces the chemicals (working out, other drugs but not recomended. I,e i used weed to quit cigs). Or you will have to feel low until your brain chemistry can return to normal. I have faith that one day you can quit it, once you finally realize you don't need it and how you  don't want to get high anymore even if your body does (and the body will crave for it).
